name: Smart Content Ads – Multi-Slot Inline Ad Placement Tool
author: Nexiby LLC

sections.description:
Smart Content Ads allows you to easily insert multiple inline advertisements within your post or page content — with advanced conditional targeting and a user-friendly tab-based interface. Designed for performance, flexibility, and compliance with modern coding standards, this plugin is ideal for bloggers, publishers, affiliate marketers, and monetization-focused site owners.

Key Features:

  • Support for 3 different ad slots with individual configuration
  • Modern tab-based admin interface for intuitive management
  • Conditional ad display for specific posts and pages
  • Insert ads after any paragraph number (fully configurable)
  • Display any custom HTML (AdSense, affiliate banner, promo text, etc.)
  • Target specific post types (posts, pages, or both)
  • Lightweight and fast — no performance bloat
  • Clean OOP structure with namespaced classes
  • Fully compatible with block and classic editors
  • Follows WordPress Coding Standards

Who Should Use Smart Content Ads?

  • Content publishers looking to increase ad visibility
  • Bloggers using Google AdSense or other monetization platforms
  • Developers seeking a flexible, multi-slot ad injector plugin
  • Website owners who need granular control over ad placement

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Smart Content Ads to configure:
    • Up to 3 different ad slots
    • Paragraph positions for each slot
    • Ad HTML content
    • Conditional display settings
    • Post/page targeting options
sections.faq:
How many ad slots can I create?

You can create up to 3 different ad slots, each with its own configuration and placement settings.

Can I control which posts or pages show ads?

Yes. The plugin includes conditional targeting that lets you specify exactly which posts and pages should display ads.

How is the admin interface organized?

The settings are organized in an intuitive tab-based interface, making it easy to manage multiple ad slots and their configurations.

Can I insert Google AdSense code?

Yes. You can paste your AdSense or other third-party ad HTML code into any of the ad slot content fields. It will be output safely.

Does it slow down my site?

No. It’s lightweight and optimized for performance, even with multiple ad slots.

Can I exclude ads from certain post types?

Yes. In the settings, you can choose which post types (e.g., post, page) to enable ads on, and even target specific posts/pages.

Will this work with my theme or page builder?

Yes. The plugin hooks into the_content(), which is supported by nearly all modern WordPress themes and builders.
